blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Police and school authorities in the town of Bacarra in Ilocos Norte are investigating separate reports involving an alleged shooting threat at Bacarra National Comprehensive High School (BNCHS) on Thursday, Oct. 1. An individual was allegedly heard saying a shooting might occur inside the school. The police immediately coordinated with school officials and implemented security measures. READ: Mapua Laguna to intensify campus security after reported concern BNCHS, meanwhile, said one concern involved a learner who allegedly posted threats against public safety on social media.
